notes.title: Christmas adventure (Hooligan Vasja - Christmas DLC)
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25969182/67df838dcdeb5ab61a7b83e6210ad61ac7e9aea7.png[/img]

Vasja will not vandalize and disturb the neighbors to celebrate the New Year this time. Delivering presents to the children, who were waiting for them for a year is our goal. Throw presents in luminous windows (SPACE button or middle mouse button), Bad characters will hinder you in achieving your goal. But you can shoot down them with snowballs. When you deliver all of the presents to the house and get to roof, you will have to overcome the boss shooting his weak spot.

Changes in new DLC
- completely changed graphic arts
- new sounds and music added
- redesigned gameplay
- bosses behaviors became diverse
- added new Christmas achievements
- new leaderboard for this addon

http://store.steampowered.com/app/560910/

http://store.steampowered.com/app/515910/

notes.title: Merry Christmas to everybody! Happy New Year!
notes.content:
